verdict.rationale: Fireflies documents admin-facing controls: a Rules Engine for automating meeting access/privacy, Super Admin capability to view/query all team data while normally respecting per-user privacy settings, audit logs via API, and private/dedicated cloud storage options, plus a share-meeting tool with expiry and folder/channel moves. This covers admin visibility and some granular controls, but there's no explicit documentation of default privacy state for new notes, or fine-grained per-link/per-folder permission settings beyond channel moves. missing for 10: explicit private-by-default note settings, detailed link-level permission granularity, independent/hands-on confirmation of these admin controls in practice.
